title: Circle Of Heros
description: Embark on an exciting journey with Circle of Heroes, a fast-paced arcade game that tests your reflexes and strategy. In this game, you control a rotating circle of heroic characters, each with their unique abilities. The objective is simple yet challenging: match the falling heroes with the corresponding hero on the circle to earn points and progress through the levels.
instructions: Start the Game Tap the play button to begin Control the Circle Rotate the circle of heroes by tapping left or right on the screen Match the Heroes Match the falling hero with the corresponding hero on the circle by aligning them Earn Points Success
